{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -c "
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)

# Test R07: idempotency token
ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
result1 = w.apply(ops, token='tok1')
print(f'first apply: {result1}')
assert result1 == [1]
assert len(db) == 1

# Same token, same ops -> return cached result without re-mutating
result2 = w.apply(ops, token='tok1')
print(f'second apply (same token): {result2}')
assert result2 == [1]
assert len(db) == 1  # No double insert

# Same token, different ops -> ValueError
try:
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}], token='tok1')
    print('FAIL: should have raised')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: different ops with same token raises ValueError')

# Invalid tokens
try:
    w.apply(ops, token='')
    print('FAIL: empty token accepted')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: empty token rejected')

try:
    w.apply(ops, token=123)
    print('FAIL: non-string token accepted')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: non-string token rejected')

# None means normal operation
result3 = w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}}], token=None)
print(f'normal apply: {result3}')
assert result3 == [2]
assert len(db) == 2
"
